This resume had nothing left to do. The brief was built from head `cc146663d9`, but the lane had already finished 2 minutes after it was written. I made no new commit, so the head CI passed on is still what will fold.

**PR #263 as it stands:**
- **Head:** `9afbc48b20`, marked ready at 19:24Z.
- **CI:** passed (two builds and the check). GitHub reports the PR as MERGEABLE/CLEAN.
- **`Files:` line:** matches `git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD` exactly.
- **Lane notes:** `docs/lanes/shadetie224b/NOTES.md` already explains why attempt 1 did not finish: it was waiting on the device arm and never posted a waiting comment. The notes also record the arm verdict.

**The arm verdict:** it failed 1 of 370 checks.
- **Gains:**
  - All 18 family-B captures (the Shade model off-by-one) are now exact.
  - `Lighting_range/Directional` stayed at 224.
  - 104 captures improved, and none that was exact regressed.
  - No capture was unreadable, and coverage was full in both arms.
- **The failed check:** `Specular_back/SpecParams_FF_Pow0_1` went from 1259 to 1280 px (+21, all off by one). That capture reads 1259 on every run with seven different apks, so the change caused it, not device noise.

The host then accepted that trade and labelled the PR `regression-accepted:224` at 19:33Z. The +21 stays open on #224 as the next family-B item. The notes point at the back-face specular path as the cause, because the front-face twin of that capture improved.

I posted a `[lane.shadetie224b]` comment on #263 saying this resume was a no-op and giving the current state.
